SELECT B.* FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM rnum, A.* FROM ( SELECT m.menu_no as menuNo, m.menu_nm as menuNm, m.ctgry_no as ctgryNo, c.ctgry_nm as ctgryNm, m.menu_price as menuPrice, m.menu_cn as menuCn, m.menu_regist as menuRegist, m.menu_del as menuDel, (select file_save_locate from file_detail fd where fd.file_group_no = m.file_group_no and rownum = 1) as previewPath FROM TEAM3_202407F.MENU m LEFT JOIN TEAM3_202407F.CTGRY c ON m.ctgry_no = c.ctgry_no
ORDER BY m.menu_no asc ) A WHERE ROWNUM <= #{page} * 10 ) B WHERE B.rnum > (#{page} - 1) * 10

SELECT m.menu_no, m.menu_nm, m.ctgry_no, m.menu_price, m.menu_cn, m.menu_regist, m.menu_del, m.file_group_no, fg.file_group_nm, fg.file_regdate, fg.file_group_ty, fd.file_no, fd.file_original_name, fd.file_save_name, fd.file_save_locate, fd.file_size, fd.file_ext, fd.file_mime, fd.file_fancysize, fd.file_save_date, fd.file_downcount, fd.file_save_locate || '/' || fd.file_save_name as file_path FROM TEAM3_202407F.MENU m LEFT JOIN TEAM3_202407F.FILE_GROUP fg ON m.file_group_no = fg.file_group_no LEFT JOIN TEAM3_202407F.FILE_DETAIL fd ON fg.file_group_no = fd.file_group_no WHERE m.menu_no = #{menuNo} AND m.menu_del = 1 ORDER BY fd.file_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TEAM3_202407F.MENU ( menu_no, menu_nm, ctgry_no, menu_price, menu_cn, menu_regist, menu_del ) VALUES ( (SELECT NVL(MAX(menu_no), 0) + 1 FROM TEAM3_202407F.MENU), #{menuNm}, #{ctgryNo}, #{menuPrice}, #{menuCn}, SYSDATE, 1 )
mapper.update: UPDATE TEAM3_202407F.MENU SET menu_nm = #{menuNm}, ctgry_no = #{ctgryNo}, menu_price = #{menuPrice}, menu_cn = #{menuCn} WHERE menu_no = #{menuNo} AND menu_del = 1
UPDATE TEAM3_202407F.MENU SET menu_del = 2 WHERE menu_no = #{menuNo} AND menu_del = 1
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TEAM3_202407F.MENU m LEFT JOIN TEAM3_202407F.CTGRY c ON m.ctgry_no = c.ctgry_no

SELECT m.menu_no, m.menu_nm, m.ctgry_no, m.menu_price, m.menu_cn, m.menu_regist, m.menu_del, m.file_group_no, fg.file_group_nm, fg.file_regdate, fg.file_group_ty, fd.file_no, fd.file_original_name, fd.file_save_name, fd.file_save_locate, fd.file_size, fd.file_ext, fd.file_mime, fd.file_fancysize, fd.file_save_date, fd.file_downcount FROM TEAM3_202407F.MENU m INNER JOIN TEAM3_202407F.FILE_GROUP fg ON m.file_group_no = fg.file_group_no INNER JOIN TEAM3_202407F.FILE_DETAIL fd ON fg.file_group_no = fd.file_group_no WHERE fd.file_no = #{fileNo} AND m.menu_del = 1
